# lmw search

Search people, companies, schools or groups

### Synopsis

Search like the search box of the website. TYPE is companies, groups, people, schools.

Posts can't be searched: the website serves that search in a format lmw
does not read. For jobs, use `lmw jobs search`.

```
lmw search TYPE KEYWORDS... [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw search people grace hopper
  lmw search people "go developer" --network 2nd -n 20
  lmw search companies analytical engines
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help              help for search
  -n, --limit int         number of results (1-50) (default 10)
      --network strings   people only: keep these connection degrees (1st, 2nd, 3rd)
```
